name: Rocky Trail, Bottleneck Pass
desc1: This rough trail leads upwards in a fairly steep climb, with many
desc2: large rocks making it a troublesome journey. The air at this elevation
desc3: is quite crisp and cool, and gets colder the higher you go up. The
desc4: jagged stone walls rise up at the sides of the trail here, and narrow
desc5: considerably, making a bottleneck barely allowing two to walk abreast.
desc6: The path winds through this pass, and you catch glimpses of an odd,
desc7: ancient-looking structure above and to the south.
